Nearest / distinct payoff: `vanishing-gradients` → `gradient-fades-with-depth` (existing registered artifact; evidence applicability pending). Unlike a plain vanishing-gradient chain, this adds an identity derivative and tests its exact cancellation boundary.

Primary finite model: Three scalar layers plain h←.1h have derivative .001; residual h←h+.1h has derivative1.331 at the same depth. h0=1 produces the same respective outputs.

Countercase and boundary: Residual branch weight-1 cancels identity and yields derivative0; skip connections do not guarantee nonzero gradients for every weight setting.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict which derivative survives three layers; recall a branch value that cancels the skip.

Required evidence: Expose branch and identity contributions; no claim of guaranteed successful training or empirical accuracy gain.
